task: How is the company doing this week?
answer:
Support tickets rose 86% to 54 this week, with 28 complaints per 100 orders and 10 overdue commitments.

- Revenue grew 25% to $17,949 while orders increased 25% to 191, driven in part by the FEST40 campaign.
- On-time delivery rate is 85%, with Hub W2 recording the weakest on-time rate at 77% and 14 parcels late now.
- 'Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west' assumed Hubs can handle the sale volume within daily capacity; this week it is 157%.
- 'Promise 2-day delivery to west customers' assumed West deliveries via Hub W2 are 85% on time; this week it is 77%.
